objects: Use case: stylized-concept. Production GAME ASSET ATLAS, transparent background. References: first approved forest E composition for subjects, second master Bright Handheld pixel art for mandatory style. Create ONE transparent sprite sheet in a strict 4 columns by 3 rows grid, each object fully isolated with generous transparent gutters. No background scene, no text, no grid lines. Crisp hard pixel clusters, original Vietnamese xianxia, top-down 3/4, saturated mint greens, cyan, warm timber, vermilion roofs. EXACT row-major objects: row 1: (1) abandoned wooden cottage with red tiled roof 30% collapsed, broken beams and vines, full building; (2) broad low mossy stone terrace wall horizontal segment, grass top; (3) broad short flight of gray stone stairs rising to north with grass sides, no rails blocking passage; (4) fallen timber log with roots. Row 2: (1) small walking root stump monster with leaf sprouts; (2) orange-capped mushroom monster cream stem feet; (3) coiled emerald bamboo snake with yellow belly and leaf crest; (4) stout moss-backed stone beast with cyan jade crest. Row 3: (1) slender medicinal emerald grass clump; (2) delicate white dew flowers with green leaves; (3) purple layered lingzhi fungus; (4) cyan jade-leaf medicinal plant. All sprites whole, separated, centered individually within equal cells. Assets fill 70-80% of each cell. No embedded ground squares or checkerboard. Real alpha. Not a mockup.
combat: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a transparent production side-view combat sprite sheet, 6 columns and 2 rows, generous transparent gutters. Reference master Bright Handheld for crisp pixel-art style and forest E for creature identity. Row 1 emerald bamboo snake with yellow belly, leaf crest. Row 2 bulky moss-covered stone beast with cyan jade crest. EACH row has EXACT SIX whole-body separate poses all facing RIGHT: idle, slither/walk step 1, step 2, raised springing pose, attack thrust/bite, crouched charging warning pose. Side-view for horizontal platform combat, consistent scale and identity within each row, feet baseline stable; snake entire coil visible. Creature only with genuine alpha background, no scenery, ground tiles, text, borders, numbers, effects outside cell, blur or smooth 3D. Original Vietnamese xianxia chibi pixel creatures, deliberate hard pixel clusters. Each object occupies at most 80% cell.
packing: Production atlas source rectangles measured and packed to individual transparent 256px material icons; source retained.
